## What We Do
Stone Works Remodeling handles the complete range of bathroom projects in Michigan — there is no project too modest and none too ambitious. The same licensed team that installs an affordable tub-to-shower conversion in Westland also builds book-matched marble master bathrooms in Birmingham and Bloomfield Hills. Every project, at every budget, includes a free in-home consultation with photorealistic 3D design renderings, an itemized written quote, a dedicated project manager, and a 5-year workmanship warranty.

### Core Services

**Complete Bathroom Remodeling (all budgets)**
Full renovations including demolition, new waterproofing, custom tile, vanity, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and finish work. Most standard projects finish in 5–10 business days. Pricing: $8,000 – $60,000+ depending on size, materials, and scope.

**Budget-Friendly Bathroom Updates**
Targeted, high-impact refreshes for cost-conscious homeowners: shower retiling, vanity and countertop replacement, new flooring, fixtures, lighting, and paint. Pricing: $5,000 – $10,000. We give honest advice on where to spend and where to save.

**Tub-to-Shower Conversion (most popular service)**
Remove the old bathtub, install a fully custom tiled walk-in shower with niches, bench, glass enclosure, and proper waterproofing membrane. Typically completed in 3–5 days. Pricing: from $7,995 all-inclusive.

**Walk-in Tub Installation (accessibility / aging in place)**
Accessible tubs with door-style entry, grab bars, anti-slip flooring, and therapeutic options for seniors and homeowners with mobility needs. We also build curbless (zero-threshold) walk-in showers with built-in benches and integrated grab bars. Pricing: $5,000 – $15,000.

**Luxury Master Bathroom Design**
Spa-level renovations for Michigan's premium communities: book-matched Calacatta and Statuario marble, natural stone slab showers, heated stone floors, steam showers with digital controls, freestanding soaking tubs, frameless glass wet rooms, backlit mirrors, and champagne-brass or matte-black designer fixtures. Curated material samples brought to your home. Pricing: $30,000 – $75,000+.

**Custom Stone & Tile Work**
Marble, slate, quartzite, granite, travertine, zellige, and large-format porcelain for shower walls, floors, vanity tops, and feature walls.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How much does a bathroom remodel cost in Michigan / Metro Detroit?**
Small update: $5,000–$10,000. Tub-to-shower conversion: from $7,995. Mid-range full remodel: $15,000–$30,000. Walk-in tub: $5,000–$15,000. Luxury master bathroom: $30,000–$60,000+. All quotes are free, in-home, and itemized line by line.

**Can you work with a small budget?**
Yes. We regularly complete $5,000–$10,000 projects and give honest guidance on the highest-impact upgrades at any budget. We will tell you plainly what your budget can and cannot achieve.

**Do you do luxury / high-end bathrooms?**
Yes — luxury master bathrooms with marble, natural stone, heated floors, steam showers, and spa styling are a core specialty, particularly in Birmingham, Bloomfield Hills, West Bloomfield, Grosse Pointe, Shelby Township, Troy, and Rochester.

**How long does a bathroom remodel take?**
Most standard remodels: 5–10 business days. Tub-to-shower conversions: 3–5 days. Luxury natural-stone projects: 2–3 weeks.

**Are you licensed and insured in Michigan?**
Yes — fully licensed and insured. All work complies with local building codes, and we pull all required permits and schedule inspections for our clients.

**Do you offer financing?**
Yes, flexible financing is available for qualified homeowners — ask during your consultation.

**What warranty do you offer?**
A 5-year workmanship warranty on every project, at every budget level, plus pass-through manufacturer warranties on fixtures and materials.

**Do you handle accessibility and aging-in-place remodels?**
Yes — walk-in tubs, curbless showers, grab bars integrated into the tile design, comfort-height fixtures, and slip-resistant stone. We provide honest recommendations on walk-in tub vs. walk-in shower based on the person's needs.

**Do you work on older homes?**
Yes — we have extensive experience with pre-1980 Detroit-area homes: plaster walls, cast-iron plumbing stacks, legacy wiring, and vintage cast-iron tubs (keep, refinish, or remove).

**Are you a national franchise?**
No. Locally owned and operated. Owner Valjon Qejvani personally oversees every project. We install real custom tile with full waterproofing membranes — not acrylic overlay systems.
